output.semantics: CenterFace heatmap, scale, offset and five-landmark tensors exposed as ONNX outputs 537, 538, 539 and 540. The adapter downsizes only when the source long edge exceeds 1600 pixels, rounds each tensor dimension up to a multiple of 32, decodes stride-4 boxes and landmarks, and applies deterministic NMS.

trainingData.name: WIDER FACE
trainingData.notes: The CenterFace paper and repository report WIDER FACE training/evaluation. The project records the upstream repository licence as provisional weight evidence but does not assert separate training-data rights or permission to train or redistribute derived weights.
